trends.name: Iran-Israel Military Escalation
trends.summary: Iran launched retaliatory strikes on Israel and U.S. assets following security chief Larijani's death, with unconfirmed reports of attempted eliminations in Tehran and drone attacks on U.S. diplomatic facilities near Baghdad. Russia is supplying Iran with upgraded drone targeting technology, escalating regional tensions and threatening Middle East stability.

trends.name: Oil Markets Under Pressure
trends.summary: Oil prices remain elevated around $100/barrel through mid-2026 despite U.S. crude inventory builds offsetting UAE infrastructure attacks. Airlines canceling flights due to fuel costs and energy becoming a non-factor for CPI could rapidly change, creating both inflation and demand destruction risks.

trends.name: Nvidia AI Dominance & Orders
trends.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang announced resumed manufacturing and new orders from China, while declaring OpenClaw as 'definitely the next ChatGPT.' Despite $1 trillion revenue forecasts and a major GTC showcase, the stock barely moved, suggesting valuations may already be priced in.

trends.name: Fed Rate Decision & Asia Markets
trends.summary: South Korea's Kospi and broader Asian equities make cautious gains ahead of Fed rate verdict. Japan's exports beat with 4.2% February growth but China and U.S. demand slumping, raising questions about Fed timing and global growth trajectory.

trends.name: China Housing Market Collapse
trends.summary: New home prices in 70 Chinese cities fell 3.2% YoY in February—the steepest annual drop in 8 months—with prices now falling in 44 of the last 47 months, the longest streak in history. Resale markets remain weak across all tiers, signaling deep structural issues.

trends.name: Tariff Impact on Retailers
trends.summary: Lululemon reports weak guidance as proxy battle and tariffs weigh on margins and sales. Gas price spikes may reduce discretionary spending, with broader implications for consumer-facing stocks dependent on pricing power and supply chain flexibility.

trends.name: AI Infrastructure & Power Demand
trends.summary: Broadcom faces potential $1 trillion valuation misunderstanding as data center communications and photonics innovation drive demand; however, Nebius stock fell as investors face wake-up call on AI infrastructure cost competitiveness. ZTR offers 8.8% yield aligned with AI growth.

trends.name: Tesla Battery & EV Supply Chain
trends.summary: Tesla to buy $4.3 billion of LG Energy battery cells from disbanded GM plant, securing critical supply as EV competition intensifies. Move signals Tesla's vertical integration strategy and competitive advantage in battery procurement.

trends.name: Geopolitical Energy Realignment
trends.summary: U.S. easing Venezuela sanctions to unlock more oil amid Iran war, while Cathay Pacific cancels all Dubai and Riyadh flights through April 30. Hong Kong dollar weakens to lowest since August as regional instability spreads; Japan's military posture shifts amid Hormuz tensions.

trends.name: Activist Investor Market Activity
trends.summary: Elliott Management builds 'significant' stake in Japan's Mitsui OSK, sending shares to record highs. Institutional investors deploying capital in overlooked value plays, signaling broader activist pressure across undervalued assets.

trends.name: Pharma Sector Skepticism
trends.summary: Eli Lilly receives rare downgrade as analysts question GLP-1 pill hype and Zepbound's actual cash sales delivery. Market sentiment shifting from obesity treatment euphoria to skeptical realism on profitability and adoption rates.

trends.name: Tech Valuation Reality Check
trends.summary: Docusign and SanDisk quiet AI boom potential signal hidden value opportunities, while Lululemon's new gear strategy faces Wall Street skepticism. Market rotating between mega-cap AI consensus plays and overlooked fundamentals-driven stories.
